cards.t: Hyperliquid Gains Momentum Following US Perps Expansion Plans
cards.b: Hyperliquid's HYPE token rose amid plans for US perpetual futures unveiled in collaboration with Trade[XYZ] and NYSE owner ICE, alongside an indirect investment from Stanley Druckenmiller.

per.HYPE: Pushed toward all-time highs on the partnership and regulatory expansion news.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch date for the regulated US derivatives offering.

cards.t: Polymarket Suspends Trading Following Security Incident
cards.b: Polymarket paused trading and relayer actions after a third-party provider compromise led to user account drains and stolen funds.

per.POL: Impacted as suspected exploiter wallets hold tokens linked to the platform.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for when trading will safely resume and full remediation steps.

cards.t: Binance Suffers $6.3B Hack and Plans Withdrawal Restart
cards.b: Binance experienced a $6.3 billion security breach, prompting the exchange to set aside corporate funds to cover losses and target a Sunday withdrawal restart after freezing about $3 billion in assets.

per.BNB: Faced downward pressure following the security breach.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full details of the exact recovery of all funds and finalized proof of reserves report.

cards.t: Strategy Reports Record Operating Income and High Bitcoin Holdings
cards.b: Strategy announced $21 billion in quarterly operating income alongside 848,517 BTC in holdings, as CFO Andrew Kang resigned and Michael Saylor touted potential digital credit capacity.

per.BTC: Backed by continued large-scale corporate treasury alignment.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific timing and amounts for upcoming planned BTC acquisitions.

cards.t: Switzerland Set to Launch First Retail Spot Bitcoin ETF in November
cards.b: Switzerland approved its first retail spot Bitcoin ETF for launch on the SIX Exchange in November 2026, targeting limited access for Swiss investors.

per.BTC: Benefiting from institutional product availability and regulated regional exposure.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact day of November for the exchange debut.
